Slow your breathing to a steady 5 second inhale and 5 second exhale, a rhythm often used for resonance breathing to encourage a calmer, more balanced state. By the end of this guided session, you may notice a quieter mind, steadier breathing, and a greater sense of ease. Sometimes the fastest way to feel better is to slow down.
